description: Study procedures before informed consent. Subjects with any study procedure or assessment dated before the informed consent date, or with study data but no consent date.
columnHeading:
1. Country
2. Site
3. Subject
4. Consent date
5. Earliest assessment date
6. Form with earliest assessment
7. Days before consent
logic:
Scenario 1: Consent date is not null AND the earliest date on any assessment form (labs, vital signs, ECG, medical history excluded) < Consent date.
Scenario 2: Consent date is null AND the subject has at least one submitted assessment form.
Exclude deleted forms. Compare dates as dates. If a date is partial, state the imputation used.
reportScenarios:
Scenario 1 - YES: Any assessment dated before consent, or any data with no consent date.
Scenario 2 - NO: All assessments are on or after the consent date.

description: Eligibility criteria not met. Randomized or enrolled subjects with an inclusion criterion answered No, or an exclusion criterion answered Yes.
columnHeading:
1. Country
2. Site
3. Subject
4. Criterion type
5. Criterion number
6. Response
7. Randomization date
8. Deviation recorded
logic:
Scenario 1: Inclusion form item = "No" for any criterion AND the subject has a randomization date.
Scenario 2: Exclusion form item = "Yes" for any criterion AND the subject has a randomization date.
Show whether a protocol deviation or waiver is recorded for the subject.
reportScenarios:
Scenario 1 - YES: A criterion that blocks eligibility is failed and the subject was randomized.
Scenario 2 - NO: All inclusion criteria are Yes and all exclusion criteria are No, or the subject is not randomized.

description: Randomized subjects with no eligibility data. Subjects with a randomization record but no inclusion/exclusion form, or an incomplete one.
columnHeading:
1. Country
2. Site
3. Subject
4. Randomization date
5. Inclusion form status
6. Exclusion form status
logic:
Scenario 1: Randomization record exists AND the inclusion form does not exist or its status is not submitted.
Scenario 2: Randomization record exists AND the exclusion form does not exist or its status is not submitted.
reportScenarios:
Scenario 1 - YES: Randomized with a missing or unsubmitted eligibility form.
Scenario 2 - NO: Both eligibility forms are submitted.

description: Age outside the protocol range. Subjects whose age at consent is outside the allowed range.
columnHeading:
1. Country
2. Site
3. Subject
4. Date of birth
5. Consent date
6. Age at consent
7. Minimum age
8. Maximum age
logic:
Scenario 1: Age at consent = whole years between Date of birth and Consent date. Age < [protocol minimum] OR Age > [protocol maximum].
If the date of birth is partial, say how the age is derived. Missing date of birth or consent date: list separately as Not derivable.
reportScenarios:
Scenario 1 - YES: Age at consent is below the minimum or above the maximum.
Scenario 2 - NO: Age is within range.

description: Randomization before eligibility confirmed. Subjects randomized on or before the date eligibility was completed.
columnHeading:
1. Country
2. Site
3. Subject
4. Eligibility completion date
5. Randomization date
6. Days between
logic:
Scenario 1: Randomization date < the latest of the inclusion and exclusion form dates.
Compare dates as dates; list ties for review.
reportScenarios:
Scenario 1 - YES: Randomization is dated before eligibility was complete.
Scenario 2 - NO: Eligibility completed before randomization.

description: Possible duplicate subjects. Subjects at different sites, or repeated at one site, who share the same date of birth, sex and initials.
columnHeading:
1. Country
2. Site
3. Subject
4. Initials
5. Date of birth
6. Sex
7. Matching subject
logic:
Scenario 1: Two or more subjects with the same Date of birth, Sex and Initials (self-comparison on the demographics form).
Only full dates of birth count. Show each pair once.
reportScenarios:
Scenario 1 - YES: Same date of birth, sex and initials appear on more than one subject.
Scenario 2 - NO: No other subject matches.
sorting: Date of birth, Initials, Site, Subject

description: Screen failures with later data. Subjects recorded as screen failures who have visits or dosing after the screening disposition.
columnHeading:
1. Country
2. Site
3. Subject
4. Screen failure date
5. Latest later data date
6. Form
logic: Scenario 1: Disposition = "Screen failure" AND the subject has submitted data on any visit or exposure form dated after the screen failure date.
reportScenarios:
Scenario 1 - YES: A screen failure has data after the screening outcome.
Scenario 2 - NO: A screen failure has no later data.

description: Demographics date and value checks. Impossible or inconsistent demographic values.
columnHeading:
1. Country
2. Site
3. Subject
4. Date of birth
5. Consent date
6. Sex
7. Issue
logic:
Scenario 1: Date of birth is after Consent date.
Scenario 2: Date of birth is in the future.
Scenario 3: Sex is missing or not in the allowed codelist.
reportScenarios:
Scenario 1 - YES: Any of the three conditions.
Scenario 2 - NO: None apply.

description: Adverse events starting before consent. Adverse events with a start date before the informed consent date.
columnHeading:
1. Country
2. Site
3. Subject
4. AE term
5. AE start date
6. Consent date
logic:
Scenario 1: AE start date < Consent date. Partial start dates: compare the known parts only and say so.
Exclude deleted AE forms.
reportScenarios:
Scenario 1 - YES: AE start is before consent.
Scenario 2 - NO: AE start is on or after consent.
sorting: Country, Site, Subject, AE start date

description: AE end date before start date. Adverse events whose end date is before the start date.
columnHeading:
1. Country
2. Site
3. Subject
4. AE term
5. AE start date
6. AE end date
logic: Scenario 1: AE end date < AE start date, both dates present. Compare dates as dates. Partial dates: compare known parts only.
reportScenarios:
Scenario 1 - YES: End is before start.
Scenario 2 - NO: End is on or after start, or end is null.
sorting: Country, Site, Subject, AE start date

description: Fatal AE and death consistency. Fatal adverse events with no matching death record, and death records with no fatal AE.
columnHeading:
1. Country
2. Site
3. Subject
4. AE term
5. AE outcome
6. Date of death
7. Disposition
8. Issue
logic:
Scenario 1: AE outcome = "Fatal" AND (no death date on the disposition or death form OR death date differs from AE end date).
Scenario 2: Death date present on the disposition or death form AND no AE with outcome = "Fatal".
reportScenarios:
Scenario 1 - YES: Fatal AE without death record, or death without fatal AE.
Scenario 2 - NO: Death data and fatal AE agree.

description: Seriousness flag and criteria disagree. Serious AEs with no seriousness criterion selected, and non-serious AEs with a criterion selected.
columnHeading:
1. Country
2. Site
3. Subject
4. AE term
5. Serious
6. Criteria selected
logic:
Scenario 1: Serious = "Yes" AND no seriousness criterion (death, life-threatening, hospitalization, disability, congenital anomaly, other medically important) is selected.
Scenario 2: Serious = "No" AND at least one criterion is selected.
reportScenarios:
Scenario 1 - YES: Seriousness flag and criteria disagree.
Scenario 2 - NO: Flag and criteria agree.
sorting: Country, Site, Subject, AE start date

description: SAE reporting timeliness. Serious AEs reported later than the protocol allows.
columnHeading:
1. Country
2. Site
3. Subject
4. AE term
5. Date of awareness
6. Date reported
7. Hours or days late
logic: Scenario 1: Date reported - Date of awareness > [protocol reporting limit, often 24 hours]. If only dates are collected, compare in days.
reportScenarios:
Scenario 1 - YES: Report is later than the limit.
Scenario 2 - NO: Report is within the limit.

description: AE action taken withdraw with dosing still active. AEs where the study drug was withdrawn but dosing continues after the AE start.
columnHeading:
1. Country
2. Site
3. Subject
4. AE term
5. AE start date
6. Action taken
7. Last dose date
logic: Scenario 1: Action taken with study drug = "Drug withdrawn" AND the subject has an exposure record dated after the AE start date.
reportScenarios:
Scenario 1 - YES: Withdrawn but dosed afterwards.
Scenario 2 - NO: No dosing after withdrawal.

description: Outcome and end date disagree. Outcome says recovered with no end date, or an end date with an ongoing or not recovered outcome.
columnHeading:
1. Country
2. Site
3. Subject
4. AE term
5. AE start date
6. AE end date
7. Outcome
logic:
Scenario 1: Outcome in ("Recovered/Resolved", "Recovered with sequelae") AND AE end date is null.
Scenario 2: Outcome in ("Not recovered", "Ongoing") AND AE end date is not null.
reportScenarios:
Scenario 1 - YES: Outcome and end date disagree.
Scenario 2 - NO: They agree.
sorting: Country, Site, Subject, AE start date

description: Serious AEs missing causality. Serious AEs with no relationship to study treatment recorded.
columnHeading:
1. Country
2. Site
3. Subject
4. AE term
5. Serious
6. Relationship to study drug
logic: Scenario 1: Serious = "Yes" AND Relationship to study drug is null.
reportScenarios:
Scenario 1 - YES: Serious and causality missing.
Scenario 2 - NO: Causality is recorded.
sorting: Country, Site, Subject, AE start date

description: Duplicate AE records. AEs with the same term and start date for the same subject.
columnHeading:
1. Country
2. Site
3. Subject
4. AE term
5. AE start date
6. Record count
logic: Scenario 1: Count of AE records with the same Subject, AE term and AE start date > 1. Use GROUP BY with HAVING. Exclude deleted forms.
reportScenarios:
Scenario 1 - YES: More than one record with the same term and start date.
Scenario 2 - NO: Only one record.

description: Ongoing AEs at end of study. AEs with no end date for subjects who completed or discontinued the study.
columnHeading:
1. Country
2. Site
3. Subject
4. AE term
5. AE start date
6. Disposition
7. Disposition date
logic: Scenario 1: AE end date is null AND the subject has a disposition date (completed, discontinued or death).
reportScenarios:
Scenario 1 - YES: Open AE after the subject left the study.
Scenario 2 - NO: AE has an end date, or the subject is still active.

description: CM end date before start date. Concomitant medications ending before they start.
columnHeading:
1. Country
2. Site
3. Subject
4. Medication
5. Start date
6. End date
logic: Scenario 1: CM end date < CM start date. Partial dates: compare known parts only.
reportScenarios:
Scenario 1 - YES: End before start.
Scenario 2 - NO: End on or after start, or end null.

description: CM with no indication. Concomitant medications with no indication recorded.
columnHeading:
1. Country
2. Site
3. Subject
4. Medication
5. Start date
6. Indication
logic: Scenario 1: Indication is null AND the medication is not marked prophylaxis or study-related.
reportScenarios:
Scenario 1 - YES: Indication missing.
Scenario 2 - NO: Indication present.

description: Prohibited medication use. Medications on the protocol's prohibited list taken during the study.
columnHeading:
1. Country
2. Site
3. Subject
4. Medication
5. Coded term
6. Start date
7. End date
8. Study period
logic: Scenario 1: Coded medication term or drug class is in [protocol prohibited list] AND the medication period overlaps the treatment period (start <= last dose date AND (end is null OR end >= first dose date)).
reportScenarios:
Scenario 1 - YES: A prohibited medication overlaps treatment.
Scenario 2 - NO: No prohibited medication overlaps.

description: AE treated by medication but no CM record. AEs marked as treated with medication where no concomitant medication is linked.
columnHeading:
1. Country
2. Site
3. Subject
4. AE term
5. AE start date
6. Treatment given
7. CM records in window
logic: Scenario 1: AE Treatment given = "Yes" AND no CM record for the subject starts between the AE start date and the AE end date (or the last visit date if the AE is ongoing).
reportScenarios:
Scenario 1 - YES: Treated AE with no CM in the AE window.
Scenario 2 - NO: A CM exists in the window.
sorting: Country, Site, Subject, AE start date

description: Dosing before randomization. Subjects with a dose dated before the randomization date.

3. Subject

Scenario 2 - NO: First dose on or after randomization.

1. Country
2. Site
3. Subject
4. Discontinuation date
5. Dose date
6. Dose
logic: Scenario 1: Dose date > treatment discontinuation date from the end-of-treatment form.
reportScenarios:
Scenario 1 - YES: Dosing after discontinuation.
Scenario 2 - NO: No dosing after discontinuation.

description: Dose changes without a reason. Dose differs from the previous record with no dose modification reason.
columnHeading:
1. Country
2. Site
3. Subject
4. Previous dose date
5. Previous dose
6. Dose date
7. Dose
8. Reason
logic: Scenario 1: Compare each exposure record with the previous record of the same subject (consecutive record comparison by date). Dose <> previous dose AND Reason for dose change is null.
reportScenarios:
Scenario 1 - YES: Dose changed and no reason given.
Scenario 2 - NO: Dose unchanged, or reason present.

description: Gaps in dosing. Gaps between consecutive dosing records longer than the allowed interval.
columnHeading:
1. Country
2. Site
3. Subject
4. Previous dose end date
5. Next dose start date
6. Gap days
logic: Scenario 1: Next dose start date - previous dose end date > [protocol allowed gap, in days]. Do not list planned dose holds that have a hold reason.
reportScenarios:
Scenario 1 - YES: Gap longer than allowed without a hold.
Scenario 2 - NO: No gap, or a recorded hold.
sorting: Country, Site, Subject, Next dose start date

description: Dose above the protocol maximum. Exposure records with a dose above the allowed maximum.
columnHeading:
1. Country
2. Site
3. Subject
4. Dose date
5. Dose
6. Unit
7. Maximum dose
logic: Scenario 1: Dose (converted to the protocol unit) > [protocol maximum dose]. Say how units are converted.
reportScenarios:
Scenario 1 - YES: Dose above the maximum.
Scenario 2 - NO: Dose within limit.

description: Low treatment compliance. Subjects whose compliance is below the protocol threshold.
columnHeading:
1. Country
2. Site
3. Subject
4. Doses planned
5. Doses taken
6. Compliance %
logic: Scenario 1: Compliance % = Doses taken / Doses planned x 100 < [protocol threshold, commonly 80]. Planned doses are counted up to the discontinuation date.
reportScenarios:
Scenario 1 - YES: Compliance below the threshold.
Scenario 2 - NO: At or above.

description: Out-of-range lab with no clinical significance. Lab results outside the normal range where the investigator did not assess clinical significance.
columnHeading:
1. Country
2. Site
3. Subject
4. Visit
5. Test
6. Result
7. Unit
8. Normal low
9. Normal high
10. Clinically significant
logic:
Scenario 1: Result < Normal low OR Result > Normal high AND Clinically significant is null.
Skip records where the test was not done. Compare numbers, not text.
reportScenarios:
Scenario 1 - YES: Abnormal with no assessment.
Scenario 2 - NO: In range, or assessed.

description: Clinically significant lab with no AE. Clinically significant lab values with no adverse event reported near the collection date.
columnHeading:
1. Country
2. Site
3. Subject
4. Test
5. Result
6. Collection date
7. AEs within window
logic: Scenario 1: Clinically significant = "Yes" AND no AE for the subject starts within [N days] of the collection date.
reportScenarios:
Scenario 1 - YES: Significant lab with no AE nearby.
Scenario 2 - NO: An AE exists in the window.

description: Lab units differ within a subject and test. The same lab test reported in different units across records.
columnHeading:
1. Country
2. Site
3. Subject
4. Test
5. Unit 1
6. Unit 2
logic: Scenario 1: For the same Subject and Test, the count of distinct units > 1.
reportScenarios:
Scenario 1 - YES: More than one unit.
Scenario 2 - NO: One unit.

description: Missing mandatory lab panel. Visits where a required lab panel has no data.
columnHeading:
1. Country
2. Site
3. Subject
4. Visit
5. Visit date
6. Panel missing
logic: Scenario 1: The visit occurred AND the required panel is scheduled for that visit in the schedule of assessments AND no panel record exists AND the panel was not marked not done.
reportScenarios:
Scenario 1 - YES: Required panel missing.
Scenario 2 - NO: Panel present or not done with a reason.

description: Duplicate lab results. More than one result for the same subject, test and collection date and time.
columnHeading:
1. Country
2. Site
3. Subject
4. Test
5. Collection date
6. Record count
logic: Scenario 1: Count of records with the same Subject, Test and Collection date/time > 1. Use GROUP BY with HAVING.
reportScenarios:
Scenario 1 - YES: Duplicate result records.
Scenario 2 - NO: A single result.

description: Test not done with a result. Results entered for tests marked not done, and not-done tests with no reason.
columnHeading:
1. Country
2. Site
3. Subject
4. Visit
5. Test
6. Not done
7. Reason
8. Result
logic:
Scenario 1: Not done = "Yes" AND Result is not null.
Scenario 2: Not done = "Yes" AND Reason is null.
reportScenarios:
Scenario 1 - YES: Not done conflicts with a result, or has no reason.
Scenario 2 - NO: Neither applies.

description: Implausible vital signs. Vital sign values that are physiologically unlikely or inconsistent.
columnHeading:
1. Country
2. Site
3. Subject
4. Visit
5. Test
6. Result
7. Unit
8. Issue
logic:
Scenario 1: Diastolic >= Systolic blood pressure at the same time point.
Scenario 2: Value outside [plausibility range per test, for example heart rate].
Scenario 3: Height changes by more than [N cm] between visits for an adult.
reportScenarios:
Scenario 1 - YES: A plausibility rule is broken.
Scenario 2 - NO: All values are plausible.

description: Large weight change between visits. Weight changes by more than the allowed percentage between consecutive visits.
columnHeading:
1. Country
2. Site
3. Subject
4. Previous visit
5. Previous weight
6. Visit
7. Weight
8. Change %
logic: Scenario 1: Compare each weight with the previous weight of the same subject (consecutive record comparison). ABS(Weight - Previous weight) / Previous weight x 100 > [threshold, commonly 10].
reportScenarios:
Scenario 1 - YES: Change above the threshold.
Scenario 2 - NO: At or below.

description: ECG interval and interpretation checks. ECG records with interpretation or interval problems.
columnHeading:
1. Country
2. Site
3. Subject
4. Visit
5. Time point
6. QTcF
7. Interpretation
8. Clinically significant
logic:
Scenario 1: Interpretation = "Abnormal" AND Clinically significant is null.
Scenario 2: QTcF > [alert level, commonly 450, 480 or 500 ms] without an AE.
Scenario 3: Required ECG time point has no record.
reportScenarios:
Scenario 1 - YES: Any of the three conditions.
Scenario 2 - NO: None.
sorting: Country, Site, Subject, Visit, Time point

description: Visits outside the protocol window. Visits outside the allowed window around the target day.
columnHeading:

2. Site
3. Subject
4. Visit
5. Target day
6. Actual day
7. Window
8. Days outside

Scenario 2 - NO: Within the window.

description: Visit dates out of order. Visit dates that do not follow the visit sequence.
columnHeading:
1. Country
2. Site
3. Subject
4. Visit
5. Visit date
6. Previous visit
7. Previous visit date
logic: Scenario 1: Visit date < the date of an earlier-numbered visit for the same subject. Exclude unscheduled visits.
reportScenarios:
Scenario 1 - YES: Date earlier than a previous visit.
Scenario 2 - NO: In order.

description: Data after death, discontinuation or completion. Data dated after the subject's last expected date.
columnHeading:
1. Country
2. Site
3. Subject
4. End event
5. End date
6. Form
7. Later date
logic: Scenario 1: Any visit or assessment date > the death date, study discontinuation date or completion date. Follow-up visits that the protocol allows are excluded.
reportScenarios:
Scenario 1 - YES: Data after the end.
Scenario 2 - NO: None.

columnHeading:
1. Country
2. Site
3. Subject
4. Visit
5. Expected by date
6. Days overdue
logic: Scenario 1: The subject is active (no disposition) AND the visit's window has ended before the data cut date AND no form exists for that visit.
reportScenarios:
Scenario 1 - YES: Visit overdue with no data.
Scenario 2 - NO: Visit exists, or is not due.

description: Late data entry. Forms entered much later than the visit.
columnHeading:
1. Country
2. Site
3. Subject
4. Visit
5. Visit date
6. Entry date
7. Days late
logic: Scenario 1: Entry date - Visit date > [protocol or site target, in days].
reportScenarios:
Scenario 1 - YES: Entered later than the target.
Scenario 2 - NO: Entered on time.

description: Future-dated entries. Dates later than the date the data was entered or later than today.
columnHeading:
1. Country
2. Site
3. Subject
4. Form
5. Item
6. Date
7. Entry date
logic: Scenario 1: Any date item > Entry date, or > the data cut date.
reportScenarios:
Scenario 1 - YES: Date is in the future.
Scenario 2 - NO: None.

description: Partial and unknown dates. All dates with an unknown day, month or year, grouped by form.
columnHeading:

2. Site
3. Subject
4. Form
5. Item
6. Date as entered
7. Unknown parts
logic: Scenario 1: Any date item with at least one unknown part (day, month, year or time). Show the date as entered. Do not impute for this listing.
reportScenarios:
Scenario 1 - YES: Date is not complete.
Scenario 2 - NO: Date is complete.

description: Unscheduled visits. Unscheduled visits and their reasons.
columnHeading:
1. Country
2. Site
3. Subject
4. Visit date
5. Reason
6. Related AE
logic: Scenario 1: Visit type = "Unscheduled". Show the reason and whether an AE starts within 7 days before the visit.
reportScenarios:
Scenario 1 - YES: Unscheduled visit.
Scenario 2 - NO: Not unscheduled.

description: Open queries older than the limit. Queries that have been open longer than the allowed number of days.

5. Item
6. Query text
7. Opened date
8. Days open

reportScenarios:

Scenario 2 - NO: Closed, or younger.

5. Form
6. Form status
7. Last modified
logic: Scenario 1: Form status <> submitted for a visit that has a visit date and is older than [N days].
reportScenarios:

Scenario 2 - NO: Submitted.

logic: Scenario 1: A required form for the visit has no record and was not marked not done.
reportScenarios:

description: Date sequence across the study. Subjects whose key dates are not in the expected order.
columnHeading:

3. Subject

logic:
